summary: ESLint plugin drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload at install
details: @ornikar/eslint-plugin-neverthrow@1.3.9 declares a preinstall script (node setup.mjs) that downloads the Bun runtime from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/<arch>.zip and then uses that freshly-fetched runtime to execute a bundled 727 KB heavily-obfuscated file named math_init.js at the tarball root. setup.mjs itself is written in obfuscator.io style with _0xNNNN identifiers and short helper names (mu, ra, dl, hc, xn, xb). math_init.js uses Bun-CJS packing plus string-array shuffle obfuscation and is unrelated to the package's stated purpose (an ESLint rule for neverthrow); it is only reachable via the preinstall dropper. Running npm install therefore runs opaque, non-inspectable code on the installer's machine under an alternate JS runtime that bypasses Node-based scanners.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
